| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cutoff** `cutoff` | 0.1 | 0.005 to 0.5 cycles/px | The cutoff frequency D_0, in cycles per pixel. 0.5 is the finest detail a pixel grid can hold. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Offset by 128 | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
